19: lookup.
20: """
21: _FRICTIONLESS_TO_POLARS: OrderedDict[FieldType, Callable[[pl.DataType], bool]] = (
22:     OrderedDict(
23:         {
24:             # Primary types: reverse lookup always gives back Frictionless type
25:             "number": lambda dtype: dtype.is_float() or dtype.is_decimal(),
26:             "integer": lambda dtype: (
27:                 dtype.is_integer() or isinstance(dtype, pl.Duration)
28:             ),
29:             "string": lambda dtype: isinstance(
30:                 dtype, (pl.String, pl.Categorical, pl.Enum, pl.Binary)
31:             ),
32:             "date": lambda dtype: isinstance(dtype, pl.Date),
33:             "datetime": lambda dtype: isinstance(dtype, pl.Datetime),
34:             "time": lambda dtype: dtype == pl.Time,  # Polars stores Time as a class
35:             "boolean": lambda dtype: isinstance(dtype, pl.Boolean),
36:             # Secondary types: reverse lookup gives back Frictionless type only if
37:             # primary type doesn't take precedence
38:             "array": lambda dtype: isinstance(dtype, (pl.String, pl.Array, pl.List)),
39:             "object": lambda dtype: isinstance(
40:                 dtype, (pl.String, pl.Struct, pl.Object)
41:             ),
42:             # Tertiary types: reverse lookup never gives back Frictionless type
43:             "geopoint": lambda dtype: (
44:                 isinstance(dtype, pl.Array)
45:                 and dtype.size == 2
46:                 and dtype.inner.is_numeric()
47:             ),
48:             "geojson": lambda dtype: isinstance(
49:                 dtype, (pl.String, pl.Struct, pl.Object)
50:             ),
51:             "year": lambda dtype: dtype.is_integer(),
52:             "yearmonth": lambda dtype: isinstance(dtype, pl.Date),
53:             "duration": lambda dtype: isinstance(dtype, pl.String),
54:             # Fallback type
55:             "any": lambda _: True,
56:         }
57:     )

            elif issubclass(dtype, pl.List):
                dtype_inst = pl.List(pl.Null)
            elif issubclass(dtype, pl.Enum):
